lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice regular preterite for a simple weekend recap.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Monday fika small talk about what happened during the weekend.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Narrating completed past activities in a short sequence.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik meet on Monday and talk about a calm weekend with chores, food, and a short walk.

main_focus.name: regular preterite for completed weekend actions
main_focus.description: Use regular past-tense verbs to describe completed actions from a specific past time.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use regular preterite forms naturally 5-7 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic modal verbs: kan, vill, ska
one simple reason clause with för att or därför att

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use concrete weekend verbs and time phrases for past narration.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks how the weekend was.
dialogue_shape.middle: They exchange two or three completed weekend activities in the preterite.
dialogue_shape.ending: They react briefly and return to the workday.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat regular preterite endings in familiar verbs

focus: the overall type of weekend described

sentence_focus: one question asking how the weekend was
one sentence with a specific past day
one sentence describing the weekend as calm or busy
